REPORT zcv_helper_owner.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_params,
         id TYPE i,
       END OF ty_params.

CONSTANTS gc_cmd_refresh TYPE sy-ucomm VALUE 'REFRESH'.
CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_mode,
             edit TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'E',
             show TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'S',
           END OF gc_mode.

DATA gv_mode TYPE c LENGTH 1.

* The report's constants and types belong to the owner class; the helper's
* own attribute show is no component of gc_mode.
CLASS lcl_handler DEFINITION CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA show TYPE abap_bool READ-ONLY.
    CLASS-METHODS create
      IMPORTING is_params     TYPE ty_params
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_obj) TYPE REF TO lcl_handler.
    CLASS-METHODS create_classic
      IMPORTING is_params     TYPE ty_params
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_obj) TYPE REF TO lcl_handler.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING is_params TYPE ty_params.
    METHODS clone RETURNING VALUE(ro_obj) TYPE REF TO lcl_handler.
    METHODS on_command IMPORTING iv_ucomm TYPE sy-ucomm.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA ms_params TYPE ty_params.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create.
    ro_obj = NEW lcl_handler( is_params ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_classic.
    CREATE OBJECT ro_obj EXPORTING is_params = is_params.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD constructor.
    ms_params = is_params.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD clone.
    ro_obj = NEW #( ms_params ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_command.
    IF iv_ucomm = gc_cmd_refresh.
      gv_mode = gc_mode-show.
      show = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
    WRITE / ms_params-id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  DATA(lo_handler) = lcl_handler=>create( VALUE #( id = 1 ) ).
  lo_handler->on_command( gc_cmd_refresh ).
  lo_handler = lcl_handler=>create_classic( VALUE #( id = 2 ) ).
  lo_handler->clone( )->on_command( gc_cmd_refresh ).
  WRITE / gv_mode.
